title: Tiffin Tracker Update
message: Tiffin Tracker v5.7.3 is now available!
releaseNotes: Rock-solid Room & User Lifecycle: Ground-up overhaul for flat creation, joining, approving, and kicking
Zero Ghost Resurrection: Authoritative Firestore single source of truth ensures kicked users never re-add themselves
Instant Kick & Logout: Kicked members are immediately logged out, local session purged, and returned to flat gate
Live Waiting Screen: Real-time admission for pending join requests with Admin 1-tap approval
Pure Native Android: Removed deprecated web/PWA service workers and legacy web push code
Custom Kotlin FirebaseMessagingService: Background alerts delivered directly to device lockscreen
Automated token registration keyed by member ID with instant Firestore synchronization
High-priority notification channel (tiffin_notifications) with chime sound and vibration
Custom Kotlin FirebaseMessagingService: Delivers notifications when app is closed, terminated, or locked
Web Push & FCM Service Worker (firebase-messaging-sw.js) for desktop & mobile web push
Fixed token registration timing and sender self-exclusion filter for reliable delivery
High-priority notification channel (tiffin_notifications) with lockscreen visibility and chime sound
Admin Approval Option: Require approval before new members join flat
Instant Admin Popup Alert: 1-Tap Approve/Decline notification banner with audio chime
Live Waiting Screen: Real-time admission for new roommates once approved
Secure Firebase Cloud Messaging & Firestore two-way real-time synchronization
Secure Firebase Cloud Messaging backend with lockscreen alerts
Human-crafted UI design: clean emerald & deep slate theme
Instant update routing directly to in-app installation modal
Automated fail-safe version tracking across all devices
